sentences.text: The RGISFM scheme stands for the Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Sustainable Development and Financial Management.
It aims to promote sustainable development and financial management practices in India.
The objectives include enhancing the capacity of individuals and organizations in sustainable development.
The scheme provides training and resources to improve financial literacy and management skills.
Benefits include access to educational programs and workshops on sustainable practices.
Eligibility is typically open to individuals and organizations interested in sustainable development.
The application process involves submitting an application to the Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Sustainable Development and Financial Management.
The timeline for the programs may vary based on the specific training or workshop schedule.
The implementing authority for this scheme is the Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Sustainable Development and Financial Management.
